item.title: The Athens Reform: 5 Things Every Property Investor Must Understand in 2026
item.description: For years, investing in Athenian real estate meant accepting a familiar trade-off. You bought into extraordinary cultural and economic upside, but you also bought into a bureaucratic maze, namely overlapping jurisdictions, decades-old regulations, and a permitting system that frequently rewarded local insiders and patient contractors far more than it rewarded transparent capital. That trade-off is disappearing, so let's break down what this structural shift means for your portfolio.

item.title: When the Exit Strategy Is the Smart Move: A Case Study in Mold, Hidden Leaks, and Capital-Light Asset Recovery in Athens
item.description: Not every property problem calls for a full renovation. Sometimes the smarter decision is to stabilize the asset, exit cleanly, and protect what capital remains. This case study documents exactly that scenario — and what happened when a second, hidden defect surfaced mid-execution.

item.title: Face aux canicules en France : Pourquoi j’ai choisi la résilience (et l'art de vivre) d’Athènes
item.description: Comme beaucoup d'entre nous, j'ai traversé ces derniers étés en France avec cette sensation que la chaleur urbaine devenait chaque année un peu plus lourde, étouffante et difficile à supporter. C'est ce constat qui m'a poussé à chercher une alternative et à poser mes valises à Athènes, une ville qui a appris à faire du soleil un allié plutôt qu'une contrainte.

item.title: The "Turn-Key" Trap on the Athens Riviera
item.description: A fresh coat of paint can hide severe thermal defects. Discover why a "turn-key" renovation on the Riviera might actually be a mold time-bomb for your ROI.

item.title: Welcome to the Klab – Investing in Athens with Your Eyes Open
item.description: Investing in Athens Real estate? Move beyond the "Greek Dream" and protect your capital. Join the Klab: Klehomerie’s knowledge base for technical audits, red flag scans, and asset protection.
